name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: FRESH-GSMFIELDS-RETRY BUILD (v5, detailed logging): same behavior as 0.5.3 (unconditional reinit before recreateComposeSecure, fresh nsIMsgComposeSecure per retry, delayed post-success reinit), but every action now logs a start line and a finished/FAILED line through logInfo()/logError() -- version, Date.now() timestamp, the specific step, and the error+stack on failure. Covers doCleanup() (getCerts(), the cert9.db SELECT per live cert, each deleteCertificate() attempt), reinitCertVerifier() (each pref read/write and the observer topic wait), recreateComposeSecure() (instance creation, flag copy, cache rewarm), onComposeProcessDone() (every call including its aResult, and each stage of the failure-handling chain), and the window-hooking/shutdown/lifecycle functions.
